authority: Maintained protocol for TopicLLM pilot software (release 0.7.0) and its Trump tutorial. The dissertation and original papers are separate, unchanged research.

input.benchmark_note: Separate development and held-out human annotations; retain both independent reviewers and adjudication.
python_corpus: id column named by id_column (default 'post_id'), unique
optional date YYYY-MM-DD for discovery/target windows
input.discovery: Campaign view of the canonical archive: 2015-06-16 through 2016-11-08, inclusive; 7,805 posts.
input.analysis: Presidency view of the same archive: 2017-01-20 through 2021-01-08, inclusive; 26,239 posts.

naming.system: You are an expert at naming topics.
naming.user_template: The following words represent a topic derived from {domain}: {words}. Please provide a concise, meaningful topic name that clearly summarizes these words.
naming.revision: Initial 15-token attempt retained separately after truncation failures; all final 500-vote topic tallies use a uniform 32-token ceiling. All attempt costs remain counted.

classification.system: You are an expert at classifying text into themes.
classification.user_template: Classify the following text into one of the following {N} themes: {numbered_options}.Text: {document}.Respond with verbatim classification using only the specified {N} options.
classification.none_label: The text does not fit into any of these themes
classification.codebook: Frozen JSON definitions and primary-theme rule are prepended to the classification prompt.
classification.selection: Highest development agreement, LLM on a tie; choice frozen before held-out labels are opened.
classification.acceptance: Actual researchers inspect held-out errors and approve before scaling.

human_checkpoint: Complete two-pass human theme review and record the topic-to-theme map. Agents must not invent review or consensus.

gate.per_theme: positive benchmark support and nonzero sensitivity required; inspect precision and recall and justify acceptance for the study

statistics.primary_estimand: Overall classifier-assigned theme share of 26,239 presidential posting events
statistics.denominator: exact target IDs; all resolved classifications including the residual
statistics.scope: descriptive archive measurement; no causal or public-opinion claim

reproduction_limit: Method transfer to a new corpus, not reproduction of dissertation findings. Probabilistic algorithms, seeds, model revisions and dependencies can change outputs.

quickcheck.purpose: Verify public Trump corpus hashes, IDs and date coverage

budget.public_demo: Public Trump example IDs only; 200/session/day; 600/IP/day; USD20/day and USD620/calendar month site-wide, shared with the research guide

research_guide.sources: dissertation page excerpts and public repository
research_guide.execution: explanation only; cannot access visitor files or execute research
research_guide.limits: Shared public 200/session/day; 600/IP/day; USD20/day and USD620/calendar month (UTC)

public_service.data: Server-approved examples from the public Trump corpus only. No dissertation research datasets.

tutorial.prevalence_inference: Unvalidated model-assigned shares under an explicit investigator exception; held-out acceptance criteria failed.
tutorial.current_design: Campaign discovery, human theme synthesis and independent held-out evaluation, followed by an explicitly unvalidated illustration of presidential model-assigned shares.
tutorial.prior_diagnostic: The existing whole-archive reference run is retained separately; it is not the campaign research run.

research_application.reporting: Overall presidential model-assigned shares only; classifier remains unvalidated. No temporal comparisons or causal claims.
research_application.evaluation_decision: Retain the current codebook and frozen selected classifier for the methodological demonstration; proceed to independent held-out evaluation.

dataset_introduction: Public posts from the Donald Trump account during the 2015-2016 campaign and first presidential term, through the archive endpoint of January 8, 2021. Campaign posts support discovery; first-term posts support development, the held-out check and the human-sample estimate. The classifier's full-corpus shares are an unvalidated teaching demonstration.

human_review_terminology.interpretation: theme review by two researchers, in two passes
human_review_terminology.annotation: two independent human coding passes, then adjudication
human_review_terminology.independence: Each pass is completed by a separate person without access to the other pass's labels or any model output.

presentation.research_use: Revise on development evidence, freeze, and evaluate on a fresh held-out sample until the gate and human acceptance are met.

selection_rule.admissible: candidate has at least min_topics topics and no topic holds more than max_topic_share of documents assigned to topics
selection_rule.choose: highest c_v coherence among admissible candidates; ties by earliest iteration, then smallest topic ceiling
selection_rule.rationale: Coherence alone favors a few topics dominated by common words (Roberts, Stewart & Tingley, 2019); there is no correct number of topics (Grimmer & Stewart, 2013).
selection_rule.tutorial: Formalized after the tutorial run; applied retrospectively to 894 distinct saved solutions it selects the researcher's 12-topic candidate, unchanged for caps 0.34-0.98 and for topic floors 4-12 without a cap. See docs/data/trump/campaign/selection_rule_retrospective.json.
selection_rule.override: topicllm-select-candidate records a researcher's alternative with its rationale

tutorial_finding.estimate: human-coded simple random sample of 250 of 26,239 first-term posts; two independent coding passes then adjudication
